SafetyFlag.title: SafetyFlag
SafetyFlag.description: Student safety screening flag generated by C3 AI screening or manual escalation, requiring human counselor review.

id.description: Unique identifier for the safety flag record.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the flag was created.

studentName.description: Student full name for authorized guidance counselors.

gradeSection.description: Grade level and section of the student.

companion.description: The companion chatbot involved in the conversation.

category.description: Brief category of concern (e.g. emotional_distress, self_harm_risk, personal_safety, danger_to_others).

contextSnippet.description: Minimum necessary message excerpt or context for counselor review.

triggerPhrase.description: Identified concerning expression or trigger statement.

assignedCounselorId.description: Identifier of the assigned guidance counselor.

assignedCounselorName.description: Name of the assigned guidance counselor.

actionHistory.description: Audit trail of counselor actions, timestamps, and notes.

followUpNotes.description: Confidential follow-up notes recorded by the counselor.

isDemoRecord.description: Flag indicating if this is a synthetic demonstration record.

CounselorAuditLog.title: CounselorAuditLog
CounselorAuditLog.description: Audit record of counselor access, reviews, and status changes.

action.description: Action performed (e.g. LOGIN, VIEW_FLAGS, UPDATE_STATUS, RECORD_FOLLOW_UP, CLOSE_FLAG).

flagId.description: Target flag record ID if applicable.

details.description: Specific action details or status changes.

/safety_flags/{flagId}.description: Collection of student safety screening flags requiring counselor review.

/counselor_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Secure audit trail of counselor operations and student record reviews.
